snippet.title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered | Release Window Trailer
snippet.description:
Felton House returns with renewed clarity, and a Free Upgrade Announcement:

This remastered edition enhances the original experience with improved lighting, sharper detail, and a more cohesive visual atmosphere, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5 to highlight the tension and identity that defined the first chapter of the Remothered saga.

This trailer invites you back into the unsettling atmosphere of Felton House, with a new glimpse of the remastered edition.

Free Upgrade Announcement:
We will introduce a Free Upgrade for players who purchased digital copies of Remothered: Tormented Fathers during the first seven days following the release of the remastered edition.
The remastered edition is coming in Q1 2027. More details on the free upgrade will be shared closer to launch.

Platforms: PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store

Join the official Remothered Discord server to connect with the team and the community. All official Remothered links below

Wishlist the remastered edition now:
🔗 https://remothered.com/wishlist-remastered
